paired_summary.negative_difference_means: candidate fewer stale stops; positive clean-goal difference means candidate more goals
paired_summary.uncertainty: two seed clusters, descriptive paired outcomes only; no population confidence interval

scientific_scope: two-seed bounded schedule-model development; ideal simulated sensing, no concurrent hardware timing or population/confirmation claims
verification_scope: Rehashed frozen input archive, result receipts and compact numerical evidence; independently rescored goals/safety/stale counts and timing accounting. Full archived images/native streams were verified by the frozen dispatcher; this reporter does not rerun native estimators or reverify entire output archives.
